California Privacy Rights CCPA/CPRA

This section applies to users who are California residents. Under the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 ("CCPA"), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act of 2020 ("CPRA"), you have specific rights regarding your personal information.

Applicability Notice

The CCPA/CPRA applies to for-profit businesses that meet at least one of:

  • Annual gross revenue > $25 million
  • Annually buys/sells/shares personal information of ≥ 100,000 consumers or households
  • Derives ≥ 50% of annual revenue from selling or sharing personal information

Your Rights Under CCPA/CPRA

Right to Know (§1798.110 — §1798.115)

You may request disclosure of:

  • Categories of personal information collected, sold, or disclosed
  • Categories of sources from which information is collected
  • Business or commercial purpose for collecting or selling
  • Categories of third parties with whom information is shared
  • Specific pieces of personal information collected about you

You may submit up to two requests within a 12-month period.

Right to Delete (§1798.105)

You may request deletion of personal information we have collected from you, subject to exceptions including:

  • Completing a transaction or fulfilling a contract
  • Security, fraud prevention, or legal obligation
  • Internal uses reasonably aligned with your expectations

Right to Correct (§1798.106 — CPRA)

You may request correction of inaccurate personal information we hold about you. You can update most data directly in your account settings.

Right to Opt-Out of Sale or Sharing (§1798.120)

We do not sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioural advertising. No opt-out action is required. If this practice changes, we will update this notice and provide a "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link before doing so.

Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information (§1798.121 — CPRA)

Where photographs you upload contain biometric data (e.g., facial images), you may request that we limit the use of this sensitive personal information to purposes necessary to provide the Service. We do not use face recognition to identify individuals without your explicit opt-in to that feature.

Right to Non-Discrimination (§1798.125)

We will not discriminate against you for exercising any CCPA right. We will not deny goods or services, charge different prices, provide different quality, or suggest you will receive different treatment because you exercised a CCPA right.

Appeal Process (CPRA §1798.125(b)(4))

If we deny your request, you may appeal by emailing {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} with subject "CCPA Appeal". We will respond within 45 days. If your appeal is denied, we will provide information about how to contact the California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA).

Submitting a Verifiable Consumer Request

Submit requests via:

  • Email: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} with subject line "CCPA Rights Request"

We will respond within 45 calendar days (extendable once by a further 45 days with notice). We may need to verify your identity to prevent fraudulent requests. Authorised agents may submit requests with written authorisation or a valid Power of Attorney.

Contact the California Privacy Protection Agency

California residents may also contact the CPPA: cppa.ca.gov
